description: Today, the North Carolina Fraternal Order of Police endorsed Michael Whatley for US Senate. The FOP noted that over his five decades of running for political office, Governor Cooper has always favored soft-on-crime policies that put civilians and law enforcement officers in danger. Whatley praised the FOP and committed to continue his support of law enforcement when elected to the US Senate.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: North Carolina Fraternal Order of Police Endorses Michael Whatley for US Senate – Michael Whatley for Senate
